title: Lumi MagicLight preview-only creation package

plan.objective: Prepare Lumi for one controlled character preview while preserving her approved identity and withholding production lock.
steps: Authenticate MagicLight and verify the live balance before generation.
Load the approved Lumi identity prompt and prohibit Voxie substitution.
Generate one full-body neutral-background preview only.
Run character QC against identity, silhouette, face, medallion, cape/wings, and accessory constraints.
Do not apply, lock, or use in production without explicit approval.

findings.message: The approved identity can be expressed as a preview-only operator package without changing canon status.
A successful preview would still require explicit approval and lock before production use.

details.prompt: Lumi the Wonder Scout is a separate child-friendly explorer character with an explorer suit, dark visor face, luminous blue expressions, a glowing star chest medallion, and translucent blue-light cape or wing forms. Preserve this exact identity. Full-body neutral-background preview, observant and optimistic expression, cautious gentle stance. No Voxie traits, no redesign, no new accessories, no costume change, no proportion change.

next_gate: Authenticate MagicLight, verify the live balance, and request a fresh one-preview quote before generation.
